firstPlayerRule: The youngest player takes the Leg Starting Player marker and begins the first leg.
houseFallback: If the youngest players are tied, choose randomly among them.
clarifications: The youngest player also rolls the five dice to set up the camels. The marker holder takes the first action, then turns proceed clockwise.
